svg.title: Cleaner — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as cleaner, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: A long-handled string mop stands beside a clearly separate tapered cleaning bucket and handle. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: long hair, a softly squared face.
